args.description: muay thai roundhouse kick: pivots on the lead foot and swings the rear shin in a wide powerful arc forward at rib height, then back to the high guard. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young man with spiky black hair streaked with red, red eyes, a long red scarf, an open black and red coat over a bare chest, black trousers, red and black boots
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, fists raised
